copy.title: App Toolkit | Official App Trailer
copy.headline: Everyday tools in one app
copy.description: App Toolkit for Android: Water Eject, Surface Ruler, Protractor, Unit Converter, Tip and Bill Splitter, Decision Wheel and everyday tools in one Android app.
copy.longDescription: One app. Many everyday moments. The App Toolkit name opens into the water world, where a 165 Hz tone pushes water out of a speaker; the last wave flattens into a ruler while the Surface Ruler measures 76.0 mm and the Protractor sweeps to 45 degrees; the reading becomes a unit conversion; the conversion folds into a receipt split two ways; the phone zooms into the Decision Wheel as it lands on Music, and its confetti becomes the app's tools, which gather into App Toolkit.
copy.altText: Five everyday Android tools transform from one to the next on Pixel phones before gathering into the App Toolkit icon.

output/images/frame-3.30.png.title: App Toolkit: Water Eject phone entry

output/images/frame-4.60.png.title: App Toolkit: Water Eject sound waves

output/images/frame-6.45.png.title: App Toolkit: Wave flattening into a ruler

output/images/frame-7.40.png.title: App Toolkit: Surface Ruler and Protractor

output/images/frame-8.47.png.title: App Toolkit: Protractor at 45 degrees

output/images/frame-9.90.png.title: App Toolkit: Surface Ruler at 76.0 mm

output/images/frame-11.50.png.title: App Toolkit: Length unit conversion
output/images/frame-11.50.png.altText: Two teal Material shapes display 76.0 mm and 7.6 cm beside a Pixel phone running the Unit Converter.

output/images/frame-12.60.png.title: App Toolkit: Temperature unit conversion
output/images/frame-12.60.png.altText: Morphing teal shapes convert 20 degrees Celsius to 68 degrees Fahrenheit beside the Unit Converter phone.

output/images/frame-16.00.png.title: App Toolkit: Bill split two ways

output/images/frame-17.60.png.title: App Toolkit: Decision Wheel on phone
output/images/frame-17.60.png.altText: A centred Pixel phone shows the Decision Wheel sheet with six colorful segments before the spin begins.

output/images/frame-19.00.png.title: App Toolkit: Camera push into Decision Wheel
output/images/frame-19.00.png.altText: The camera pushes closer to the spinning Decision Wheel on the Pixel phone screen.

output/images/frame-19.80.png.altText: The spinning six-choice wheel fills the frame as a lilac flower shape opens behind it.

output/images/frame-20.60.png.title: App Toolkit: Decision Wheel slowing down
output/images/frame-20.60.png.altText: The large colorful Decision Wheel spins over a lilac floral backdrop with a purple pointer at the top.

output/images/frame-21.60.png.title: App Toolkit: Decision Wheel lands on Music
output/images/frame-21.60.png.altText: The Decision Wheel stops on the Music slice with a purple Music chip badge beside it.

output/images/frame-22.30.png.title: App Toolkit: Decision Wheel confetti burst
output/images/frame-22.30.png.altText: Colorful confetti bursts from the top pointer of the Decision Wheel after selecting Music.

output/images/frame-24.40.png.title: App Toolkit: Twelve tool badges grid

output/images/frame-26.40.png.title: App Toolkit: Tool screens montage

output/images/frame-27.80.png.title: App Toolkit: Five tool screens in motion
output/images/frame-27.80.png.altText: Cards showing Water Eject, Protractor, Unit Converter, Bill Splitter and Decision Wheel glide left.

output/images/frame-30.50.png.title: App Toolkit: Closing icon and Google Play badge
output/images/frame-30.50.png.altText: The App Toolkit icon, title and Get it on Google Play badge hold at the centre as pastel ripples fade.

output/images/frame-31.00.png.title: App Toolkit: End card on Google Play
output/images/frame-31.00.png.altText: The App Toolkit icon, title and official Google Play badge centred on a clean off-white background.

output/images/transition-1-2.85.png.altText: The blue cookie shape expands toward the centre as the pale blue Water Eject background floods outward.

output/images/transition-1-3.30.png.title: App Toolkit: Water Eject phone rising in
output/images/transition-1-3.30.png.altText: The Pixel phone rises and rotates smoothly into the blue twelve-sided Water Eject backdrop.

output/images/transition-2-6.30.png.title: App Toolkit: Sound wave before flattening
output/images/transition-2-6.30.png.altText: Concentric blue sound waves radiate below the Water Eject phone just before the last arc straightens.

output/images/transition-2-6.55.png.title: App Toolkit: Wave line opening the Ruler scene
output/images/transition-2-6.55.png.altText: The straightened wave line opens the warm yellow Ruler world as the phone turns through edge-on.

output/images/transition-2-6.95.png.title: App Toolkit: Surface Ruler and Protractor arrival
output/images/transition-2-6.95.png.altText: The turned Surface Ruler phone is joined by the Protractor phone above the graduated ruler strip.

output/images/transition-3-10.35.png.title: App Toolkit: 76.0 mm reading lifting from ruler
output/images/transition-3-10.35.png.altText: The 76.0 mm measurement chip lifts onto a teal soft-burst shape above the yellow ruler strip.

output/images/transition-3-10.70.png.title: App Toolkit: Reading shape expanding into Unit Converter

output/images/transition-3-11.15.png.title: App Toolkit: Unit Converter cards emerging
output/images/transition-3-11.15.png.altText: The 76.0 mm and 7.6 cm conversion shapes settle on the left as the Unit Converter phone rises on the right.

output/images/transition-4-13.08.png.title: App Toolkit: Temperature cards sliding together
output/images/transition-4-13.08.png.altText: The 20 degrees Celsius and 68 degrees Fahrenheit shapes slide toward each other to fold into a receipt.

output/images/transition-4-13.30.png.title: App Toolkit: Coral wipe opening Tip and Bill Splitter
output/images/transition-4-13.30.png.altText: A coral soft-burst wipe opens behind the folding surface as it stretches into a white paper receipt.

output/images/transition-4-13.60.png.title: App Toolkit: Receipt and Bill Splitter phone
output/images/transition-4-13.60.png.altText: The printed receipt stands on the left while the Tip and Bill Splitter phone rises into the coral backdrop.

output/images/transition-5-16.70.png.title: App Toolkit: Decision Wheel crossfade on zooming phone
output/images/transition-5-16.70.png.altText: The zooming Pixel phone blends smoothly into the lilac Decision Wheel world.

output/images/transition-5-16.98.png.title: App Toolkit: Decision Wheel phone settling in

output/images/transition-5-17.02.png.altText: The Decision Wheel sheet with six colorful choices sits ready on the tilted Pixel phone screen.

output/images/transition-5-17.05.png.title: App Toolkit: Decision Wheel ready to spin
output/images/transition-5-17.05.png.altText: The six-segment Decision Wheel on the Pixel phone prepares to spin surrounded by lilac shapes.

output/images/transition-6-18.60.png.title: App Toolkit: Camera closing in on spinning wheel
output/images/transition-6-18.60.png.altText: The camera pushes toward the spinning Decision Wheel as the Pixel phone turns face-on.

output/images/transition-6-19.45.png.title: App Toolkit: Wheel filling the phone screen
